steps.title: Analyze Voice Service Lifecycle Issues
steps.description: Inspect the root cause of the rapid mic on/off loops and clicking sound effects in the VoiceAssistantService configuration.

steps.title: Introduce Reusable Speech Recognizer Pattern
steps.description: Adjust SpeechRecognizer initialization behavior to strictly reuse a single long-lived instance throughout the service runtime.

steps.title: Eliminate Runtime Recreate Operations
steps.description: Refactor error recovery handlers so they avoid calling destroy() and recreate() during recognition failures, eradicating the repeated beep sounds.

steps.title: Incorporate Strict Recognition State Tracking
steps.description: Introduce an isSpeechRecognizerActive state field and use it to block duplicate or overlapping SpeechRecognizer.startListening() requests.

steps.title: Configure Callback Filtering During Speaking States
steps.description: Establish absolute state-guard boundaries inside VoiceAssistantService's RecognitionListener to discard incoming callbacks while TTS speech is active.

steps.title: Implement Asynchronous Error Bypass Guard
steps.description: Design an ignoreNextError flag to correctly trap and skip transient ERROR_CLIENT errors generated from active thread cancellations.

steps.title: Refine Listening Delays and Schedules
steps.description: Adjust scheduleListening to execute with safe debounced pauses (e.g. 1200ms-2000ms) specifically after processing errors.

steps.title: Maintain Session Countdown Expiration State
steps.description: Preserve automatic fallback controls to gracefully return the service to WAKE_WORD_LISTENING mode upon active 10-minute session timeout.

steps.title: Verify Offline Utility Integrations
steps.description: Confirm flashlight, alarm, timer, device info, volume control, and calculator operations remain fully compatible with updated state handlers.

steps.title: Validate Java 8 Language Constraints
steps.description: Confirm all event declarations utilize traditional anonymous inner classes without lambdas to guarantee compiler compatibility.

steps.title: Verify Background Service Permissions
steps.description: Crosscheck FOREGROUND_SERVICE_MICROPHONE manifest specifications and confirm foreground channels deploy accurately.

steps.title: Building Popeen Voice Assistant
steps.description: Verify application stability and finalize resource compilation inside target SDK 34 specifications.
